notes.title: Visitations VR
notes.notes:
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1485260/Visitations/]Download[/url]
[url=http://visitationsvr.com]Website[/url][/b]

Visitations is an immersive gallery of vignettes designed to produce relaxed and entranced states in the user.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26939941/804c566cdba10f35998139ec90207b18194eb5dc.jpg[/img]

Visitations makes use of techniques such as binaural beats, subtle strobing, form constants, and includes a guided meditation, a dream induction, and a soundtrack developed by a healer with experience leading traditionally inspired ceremonies. Visitations creates a set & setting which allow users to turn inwards and explore their own stories and mental states.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26939941/433b3378ec3bf981f0e874009f559fbb6784fedd.jpg[/img]

Music by: East Forest

As a leader in the field of wellness, East Forest offers a spiritual yet non-religious pathway aimed squarely at the challenges of our contemporary lives. It is a process of opening doorways through myriad offerings, including his music, talks, podcast, and retreats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26939941/af6cee1327802da1bcb6b41a36b2cc148e8fc3ea.jpg[/img]

The spaces are open vessels waiting to be filled by the conscious intentions of the users. Ancient shamans intuitively understood the power of the mind, and that their performances would conjure the body’s innate ability to heal. Modern medicine accomplishes a similar effect with lab coats and pills. Visitations employs technology to similar ends.

notes.title: Cosmic Sugar Pro DLC
notes.notes:
It's been just over two years since Cosmic Sugar was released and the new DLC, Cosmic Sugar Pro, has been a year in the making.

There are now 8 instruments to play with.
Cosmic Sugar makes sound! Wear your headphones.
High resolution snapshots can easily be saved.
Performance improvements allow for even more particles.

And more!

If there is sufficient interest I plan to continue to develop these tools by adding more brushes, sound packs, pre-recorded experiences and the ability to record, save and share experiences.
